---
title: Topos documentation
description: What Topos does, and the two commands that prove it.
sidebar_label: Overview
---

Topos keeps a team's agent skills current on every machine: publish once, every
subscribed agent picks the update up at its next session start.

## What you get

Two motions, and nothing else to learn:

- **Distribute** — a published change reaches every subscribed agent automatically.
- **Contribute** — anyone proposes an improvement back to the team.

<Note>
  Receiving works for someone who never opens a terminal. Updates are silent; the
  history stays inspectable.
</Note>
